_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); ratings, education and information signals

pit_profile.why: McGraw Hill Financial 'is a leading benchmarks & ratings, analytics, data and research provider serving the global capital, commodities and commercial markets' (Item 1); Item 1A: 'Changes in the volume of securities issued and traded in domestic and/or global capital markets and changes in interest rates and volatility in the financial markets could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition or results of operations.', and no risk factor calling a business cyclical; a fall in debt issuance or the markets it serves cuts revenue, and no disruption theme is live for the business on this date

classification.quality_note: McGraw Hill Financial 'is a leading benchmarks & ratings, analytics, data and research provider serving the global capital, commodities and commercial markets' (Item 1); Item 1A: 'Changes in the volume of securities issued and traded in domestic and/or global capital markets and changes in interest rates and volatility in the financial markets could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition or results of operations.', and no risk factor calling a business cyclical; a fall in debt issuance or the markets it serves cuts revenue, and no disruption theme is live for the business on this date. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 6.03x; +35% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -0.97; conservative 2yr -1%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -39.1%/yr (worst year FY05-FY14, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +10.3%/yr (Q1 revenue + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +10.3%/yr (FY05-FY14 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +30.2%/yr (best 2-yr run FY05-FY14); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: MHFI (retrospective, 2015-05-08) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 6.03x (75.6% downside to Bear $26 / +12.5% upside to Bull $120) | Adj composite 2.30 vs market 3.27: gap -0.97 [OVERVALUED] | +35% above the EPP floor $79 (18x FY15E $4.40) | Conservative 2-yr case: -0.7% total (-0.3%/yr) | At 24.2x FY15E the 15% hurdle price $141 sits above the BULL case; Financial Services revenue +6.4% in Q1 2015, forward revenues +6.4% (no FY15 revenue guide in numbers, Q1 2015 growth); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
